name: Microsoft Sentinel — IOC hunting
description: KQL hunting queries over the tables a Sentinel workspace normally holds: firewall and proxy logs in CommonSecurityLog, Windows security events, Entra ID sign-ins, DNS and Office activity.

templates.name: Perimeter traffic towards the indicators
templates.description: Firewall, proxy and IDS logs normalised into CommonSecurityLog. Covers both directions for IP indicators.
templates.body:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, Activity, SourceIP, SourceUserName,
          DestinationIP, DestinationPort, RequestURL, DeviceAction
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Perimeter traffic in either direction
templates.description: Use this one when the indicator could be the source of an inbound attack rather than a destination.
templates.body:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where SourceIP in~ ({{iocs}}) or DestinationIP in~ ({{iocs}})
| summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Actions = make_set(DeviceAction, 10), Ports = make_set(DestinationPort, 20)
          by SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceProduct
| sort by Events desc

templates.name: DNS resolutions of the domains
templates.description: Which internal clients resolved the indicators. Requires the DNS or Sysmon connector.
templates.body:
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ClientIP, Name, QueryType, ResultCode, IPAddresses
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Entra ID sign-ins from the IP addresses
templates.description: Interactive sign-ins sourced from the indicators, with result code and conditional access outcome.
templates.body:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, IPAddress,
          Location = strcat(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), " / ", tostring(LocationDetails.city)),
          ResultType, ResultDescription, ConditionalAccessStatus, UserAgent
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Sign-in outcome per user and IP
templates.description: Collapses the sign-in noise into successes versus failures per account, which is how you spot a successful password spray.
templates.body:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| summarize Attempts = count(),
            Successes = countif(ResultType == "0"),
            Failures = countif(ResultType != "0"),
            Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
          by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| where Successes > 0
| sort by Successes desc

templates.name: Office 365 activity from the IP addresses
templates.description: Mailbox and SharePoint operations performed from the indicators — the follow-up query after a confirmed account compromise.
templates.body:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, OfficeWorkload, ClientIP, ResultStatus, Parameters
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Windows events referencing the hashes
templates.description: Sysmon process creation carries the hash in the event data; this catches it without an EDR connector.
templates.body:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, EventID, Activity, Process, CommandLine
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Do the indicators already exist in threat intelligence?
templates.description: Checks the workspace TI table before hunting, so you know whether an analytics rule should already have fired.
templates.body:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}})
| where Active == true
| project TimeGenerated, Description, ThreatType, ConfidenceScore, SourceSystem, ExpirationDateTime, {{field}}
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

templates.name: Search every table (slow)
templates.description: Last resort sweep across the whole workspace. Expensive: narrow the time range before running it.
templates.body:
search {{iocs|or-terms}}
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| summarize Hits = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by $table
| sort by Hits desc
